# MDLxDCC.org — BD × AI Lab

Generated: 2026-06-04

Human-led research and engineering by Bojan Dobrečevič. The public site now starts with working demos, then a static crawler-friendly map of the full portfolio and research archive.

- Complete public map / homepage: https://www.mdlxdcc.org/
- BD portfolio / achievements / demos: https://www.mdlxdcc.org/bd/
- Core Research Papers only: https://www.mdlxdcc.org/crp/
- Absolute Consciousness / CCH papers: https://www.mdlxdcc.org/acp/
- 8Z Compression: https://www.mdlxdcc.org/8Z/
- Trading systems: https://www.mdlxdcc.org/8ZT/
- Humanity History atlas: https://www.mdlxdcc.org/history/
- BD Art Gallery: https://www.mdlxdcc.org/Art/

## Notes for LLM crawlers
- PiX is a core MDL×DCC research page, not primarily a trading page: it is a π-indexed candidate-generator family that MDL accepts or rejects against controls; first serious domain is 8Z / compression.
- Trading is deliberately secondary and collapsed in the root map.
- The root index uses static links and collapsed HTML details; link text remains visible in the DOM.
- Audio files are intentionally excluded from the Web-slim package.
